transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Well, it's my ankles — they've both been swelling up. I first noticed it about four weeks ago.
When did you first notice it?
About four weeks ago. It's both ankles, and it's worse by the evening.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
It's worse as the day goes on — by teatime my shoes feel tight. Then in the morning, after lying flat all night, it's mostly gone again.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's not very painful, just a bit uncomfortable — I'd say about 3 out of 10. It's more that my shoes feel tight and my socks leave marks on my skin.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's both ankles and the lower part of my shins, about equally on both sides. It doesn't really spread anywhere else.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
About a 3 out of 10. It's more uncomfortable than painful, really.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It comes and goes — it builds up during the day and is worse by the evening. By the morning, after lying flat all night, it's mostly gone.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
No, nothing else really. No chest pain, no calf pain or redness in my legs, and I've not been getting breathless.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I have high blood pressure, and I've been told my kidney function is a bit reduced. I'm on tablets for those.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
Let me think... I take amlodipine — I'm still on the 5 mg one, I think. And I take a small water tablet each morning, though I can't remember its name. Oh, and simvastatin 20 mg at night.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, no allergies that I know of.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
I do sit with my feet up in the afternoons now, and I've stopped wearing my usual shoes because they've gotten too tight. Otherwise I manage.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
I suppose I am a bit frightened by it, to be honest. My sister had heart failure, and I keep worrying this swelling means the same thing is happening to me.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
